title: TFRS: Multi-Task Recommenders, Deep & Cross Networks, ScaNN, and Serving

cues.en: So let's talk about a few more advanced topics with TFRS and I'm just kind of kind of gloss over these a little bit, if you do want to go into more depth.
cues.zh: 再談幾個 TFRS 進階主題，只會概略帶過，如果想深入，

cues.en: They are on the TensorFlow website with detailed and complex examples behind each one if you want to dive into them.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 網站都有詳細、複雜範例。

cues.en: But for now, I just want to make sure you're aware of the concepts so you know where to go if you want to look it up and play with it.
cues.zh: 目前，只希望你知道概念，需要時，知道去哪裡查、實驗。

cues.en: One is the concept of multitask recommenders.
cues.zh: 一個是多任務推薦系統。

cues.en: And the idea here is that, well, imagine that you have user behavior of different types, maybe you have purchases or car ads or page views or image clicks in kind of the old way of doing things.
cues.zh: 假設有不同使用者行為：購買、加入購物車、瀏覽頁面、點圖片。舊做法，

cues.en: You would have a separate model for each one of these right?
cues.zh: 每種各有模型，對吧？

cues.en: So you'd have a recommender model that takes purchases as an input and maybe a different one that takes page views as an input.
cues.zh: 一個接受購買，另一個接受頁面瀏覽。

cues.en: You might combine their results together at the end, but fundamentally, they're all independent models for independent kinds of behavior.
cues.zh: 最後可能結合結果，但本質上，不同行為，是獨立模型。

cues.en: The insight here is that sometimes a joint model that is comprised of all of this stuff may perform better than multiple independent task specific models.
cues.zh: 新的見解是，有時包含所有行為的聯合模型，比多個各任務獨立模型更好。

cues.en: And the reason of this is sometimes if you have sparse data, like people don't really buy a lot of things right.
cues.zh: 原因是，資料可能稀疏，例如人們不太常購買，

cues.en: But they click on a lot of things.
cues.zh: 卻點很多東西。

cues.en: Maybe you're a model that takes purchases as an input would benefit from all the additional data that page views gives it.
cues.zh: 接受購買的模型，也許能受益於頁面瀏覽提供的大量額外資料。

cues.en: So if you have sparser data from one type of behavior versus another, sometimes a joint model allows the sparser data to benefit from the less sparse data as part of that model.
cues.zh: 某種行為資料較稀疏時，聯合模型能讓它受益於較不稀疏資料。

cues.en: That's why this kind of works out.
cues.zh: 所以，這樣可能有效。

cues.en: Now this means that you need to have multiple objectives and multiple loss functions and this does get rather complicated rather quickly.
cues.zh: 但需要多個目標、多個損失函數，很快就複雜。

cues.en: Again, if you want to see an example, go to Tensorflow.org/recommenders and there is one there for you to dive into.
cues.zh: 想看例子，tensorflow.org/recommenders 有。

cues.en: But it's pretty meaty stuff!
cues.zh: 內容很紮實。

cues.en: The idea is to use the concept of transfer learning to learn representations from the task with more data and transfer that to the task with less data.
cues.zh: 概念是用遷移學習，從資料多的任務，學習表示，再轉移到資料少的任務。

cues.en: And as I said, it's kind of complicated but I just want to make sure that, you know, the concept is there and available for you if you think that might apply to your problem space.
cues.zh: 如前所說，有點複雜，但希望你知道，如果問題適用，有這個概念可用。

cues.en: Another sort of advance topic is deep and cross networks.
cues.zh: 另一個進階主題，是深度交叉網路。

cues.en: The idea here is sometimes just a one to one mapping of you.
cues.zh: 有時，只是一對一映射，

cues.en: You viewed this thing, therefore these things are a good recommendation, isn't sufficient.
cues.zh: 你看這個，所以推薦那些，並不足夠。

cues.en: Sometimes there are these cross feature relationships that you might want to pick up on.
cues.zh: 有時，要捕捉跨特徵關係。

cues.en: The example they give on the TensorFlow website is, if I bought a banana and I bought a cookbook, maybe I should recommend a blender, because the combination of those two inputs, I'm interested in buying
cues.zh: TensorFlow 網站例子是，買香蕉、買食譜，也許該推薦果汁機，因為兩個輸入合起來：我想買

cues.en: fruit and I'm interested in preparing my own food taken together that might indicate an interest in a blender.
cues.zh: 水果，也想自己準備食物，可能表示對果汁機有興趣。

cues.en: But by itself, just buying a banana doesn't mean I want a blender and just buying a cookbook doesn't mean I want a blender.
cues.zh: 但單買香蕉，不代表要果汁機，單買食譜，也不代表。

cues.en: But put together it might mean I want a blender.
cues.zh: 合起來，卻可能代表。

cues.en: Getting those cross feature relationships is hard, right?
cues.zh: 找跨特徵關係，很難，對吧？

cues.en: But if there are situations where those combined features provide additional context, like the one I just gave, maybe it makes sense to explore it personally
cues.zh: 但如果組合特徵，提供額外情境，像剛才例子，也許值得探索。我自己，

cues.en: I think this is overkill and overly complex for most situations, but it's good to know that it's out there.
cues.zh: 覺得多數情況太過頭、太複雜，但知道有這東西很好。

cues.en: How does it work?
cues.zh: 怎麼運作？

cues.en: Well, the math is a little bit tricky.
cues.zh: 數學有點棘手。

cues.en: So cross networks, this is a separate thing, applies that feature crossing at each layer.
cues.zh: 交叉網路是獨立的東西，每層套用特徵交叉。

cues.en: So every cross layer looks like this mathematically.
cues.zh: 每個交叉層的數學，像這樣。

cues.en: And as you stack them on top of each other, you get more and more polynomial degrees out of that cross network.
cues.zh: 逐層堆疊，得到越來越高次的多項式。

cues.en: So the more cross network layers you add in, the more combinations of actions you can combine together to get that cross-feature information out of it. And
cues.zh: 因此，交叉層越多，就能組合更多行為，取出跨特徵資訊。

cues.en: then we pair that with a deep network, a typical multilayer Perceptron, and when we combine that deep network with the cross-network, we get what's called a deep and cross-network.
cues.zh: 再配深度網路，也就是典型多層感知器，結合深度與交叉網路，就叫深度交叉網路。

cues.en: There are two ways of doing this.
cues.zh: 有兩種做法。

cues.en: In this diagram here we've actually Statham's. So we have a cross-network that then feeds into a deep network.
cues.zh: 這張圖，實際是堆疊：交叉網路，輸入深度網路。

cues.en: You can also run these in parallel and have the cross-network operating alongside the deep network and then combining the outputs of both together into a final result.
cues.zh: 也能平行執行，交叉網路與深度網路並排，最後結合輸出。

cues.en: But fortunately, TFRS makes this relatively easy to do.
cues.zh: 幸好，TFRS 讓它相對容易。

cues.en: There is a TFRSlayers.DSDCN.cross that you can just call and it will implement this for you automatically. So you don't have to get too mired in the details of how it works.
cues.zh: 呼叫 tfrs.layers.dcn.Cross，就自動實作，不必深陷運作細節。

cues.en: TFRS will manage that for you.
cues.zh: TFRS 會處理。

cues.en: And again, there's an example of this on the TensorFlow Web site.
cues.zh: 同樣，TensorFlow 網站有例子。

cues.en: Another thing they're really proud of with TFRS is their integration into production environments, and this is a question we get pretty often in this course.
cues.zh: 他們也很自豪，TFRS 能整合正式環境；這門課經常被問，

cues.en: You know, these algorithms are really cool, but how do I scale it up?
cues.zh: 演算法很酷，但如何擴展？

cues.en: How do I actually then this to a website that wants recommendations, you know, thousands of transactions per second.
cues.zh: 如何把推薦提供給每秒數千筆交易的網站？

cues.en: Well, TFRS thought about that.
cues.zh: TFRS 想過。

cues.en: So there's a couple of aspects to this.
cues.zh: 有幾個方面。

cues.en: You know, one is just optimizing accessing the results of the retrieval stage.
cues.zh: 一是最佳化檢索結果的存取。

cues.en: So this isn't necessarily about, you know, hitting it from production, but more about optimizing that interface between the retrieval stage and the ranking stage.
cues.zh: 不一定是正式環境呼叫，而是最佳化檢索與排序介面。

cues.en: And one technique for doing that is something called approximate nearest neighbor search or ANN.
cues.zh: 一個技術，叫近似最近鄰搜尋，簡稱 ANN。

cues.en: And Google Research, as you can see, relatively recently published a paper on how to do this.
cues.zh: Google Research 如你所見，近期發表相關論文。

cues.en: And they published a package called Scan S.C.A.N.N, and that is incorporated as part of TFRS now.
cues.zh: 也發表 ScaNN，S-C-A-N-N，現在整合進 TFRS。

cues.en: So it's TFRS.layers.factoriseSCANN.
cues.zh: 也就是 tfrs.layers.factorized_top_k.ScaNN。

cues.en: And this just makes it a lot faster to access the output of your retrieval model.
cues.zh: 讓檢索模型輸出，存取快很多。

cues.en: It's about ten times faster in most cases, but it is an approximation, hence the word approximate in the name.
cues.zh: 多數情況約快十倍，但屬近似，名稱裡就有「近似」。

cues.en: So you're not going to get exactly the same results.
cues.zh: 不會完全相同結果。

cues.en: There's a price to pay for that speed, but in most cases it's close enough.
cues.zh: 速度有代價，但大多夠接近。

cues.en: The other side of the production puzzle is serving the results into a production environment.
cues.zh: 正式環境另一面，是提供結果服務。

cues.en: How to actually query the output of my model in real time at a large scale?
cues.zh: 如何即時、大規模查詢模型輸出？

cues.en: And they thought about that, too.
cues.zh: 他們也想過。

cues.en: So you can export any TFRS model into saved model format. Which is just a curious thing.
cues.zh: 可將任何 TFRS 模型，匯出 SavedModel 格式，這其實就是 Keras 的功能。

cues.en: Again, TFRS is built on top of KERIS.
cues.zh: TFRS 建立在 Keras 上。

cues.en: So you have all of this available to you and then you can serve that save model object via tensorflow serving.
cues.zh: 因此，這些都能用，再透過 TensorFlow Serving，提供 SavedModel 服務。

cues.en: And this is a architecture that Google provides for serving tensorflow models into production at large scale. Kind of similar to a sagemaker on the A.W.S. side.
cues.zh: 這是 Google 提供、在正式環境大規模提供 TensorFlow 模型服務的架構，有點像 AWS 的 SageMaker。

cues.en: And if you look at the end of the retrievals sample that we glossed over earlier, they actually have an example of creating that save model and you know, sending it off to Tensorflow serving potentially.
cues.zh: 先前略過的檢索範例最後，就有建立 SavedModel，以及可能送到 TensorFlow Serving 的例子。

cues.en: So if you want to see how that works, it's actually very straightforward to do so.
cues.zh: 想看如何做，其實很直接。

cues.en: So that's TFRS in a nutshell.
cues.zh: 這就是 TFRS 概要。

cues.en: As you can see, the basic concepts aren't too hard to grasp and it allows you to do some fancier stuff, too.
cues.zh: 基本概念不難，也能做更精細的事。

cues.en: So I expect to see a lot of growth and usage of TFRS in the future.
cues.zh: 因此，我預期 TFRS 未來會有大量成長與使用。
